sources.Defaults.roc:
Defaults := [].{
    Config := { value : I64 ?? 42 }
    get : Config -> I64
    get = |{ value }| value
    id = |x| x
    direct = get({}) == 42
    polymorphic = get(id({})) == 42
    mapped = List.map([{}, {}], get) == [42, 42]
}
expect Defaults.direct
expect Defaults.polymorphic
expect Defaults.mapped
sources.AnnotatedDefaults.roc:
AnnotatedDefaults := [].{
    Config := { value : I64 ?? 42 }
    id : a -> a
    id = |x| x
    value : Config
    value = id({})
    repeated : List(Config)
    repeated = List.repeat({}, 2)
    mapped : List(Config)
    mapped = List.map([1, 2], |_| {})
    values = |xs| List.map(xs, |item| item.value)
}
expect AnnotatedDefaults.value.value == 42
expect AnnotatedDefaults.values(AnnotatedDefaults.repeated) == [42, 42]
expect AnnotatedDefaults.values(AnnotatedDefaults.mapped) == [42, 42]
